verdict.rationale: Dialpad documents its own ability to assign an operator to a call queued in a contact center, which covers the assignment part of the story for contact-center calls. Its unified app combining calling, messaging and contact center fits the shared-team setting, but nothing shows the other elements of the story. Missing for 10: explicit shared-number or shared-inbox support for multiple teammates, presence and availability indicators, internal threads or notes on conversations, assignment of messaging conversations (not just queued calls), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
